sources.description:
陽靚首封后致詞瞬間

第23屆台北電影節頒獎典禮於10月9日在台北舉行，最佳女主角獎由《愛．殺》中的陽靚首度奪得。她為了詮釋同志更生人的角色，不僅剪掉50公分長髮，還改掉茹素習慣，展現強烈的表演張力。

頒獎典禮由去年影后王淨與李烈共同主持。陽靚上台後深情致詞，將獎項獻給家人、朋友與另一半，並以「你永遠都不知道此刻做的選擇會帶你去哪」鼓勵大家勇敢追夢。現場氣氛莊重而溫馨，成為當晚最動人的時刻。

愛·殺 (Love·Kill) Poster

Passionate Bedroom Embrace

In this still from the erotic thriller Wrath of Desire, Yang Liang and Weng Jia-wei engage in a deeply intimate same-sex bed scene. Soft, warm light filters through window bars, casting gentle shadows across their entwined forms. Yang, dressed in a light hoodie, leans over Weng, who lies back in a gray top, as they share a fervent kiss. The framing highlights the vulnerability and intensity of their connection, underscoring the film’s exploration of desire, body, and gender.

sources.description:
Ariel Ann Portrait

Ariel Ann appears against a soft turquoise background, dressed in a white top under a dark navy jacket paired with blue jeans. Her shoulder-length brown hair is styled in loose waves, and she smiles gently at the camera. Delicate layered necklaces and a silver bracelet add subtle elegance to her casual ensemble.

Born on March 5, 1985, in Taiwan, Ariel Ann is recognized for her performances in Game (2016), Ba Ji Teenagers (2015), and Di Renjie zhi lunhui tu (2018). This photograph is taken from her IMDb profile, reflecting her approachable and relaxed public persona.
